example.title: Hold a large data export for review
example.body: A higher-education restricted-data export runs through one example rule. Change the row count, then approve or reject as the example reviewer.
example.workflowBody: An agent requests an export of 3,120 restricted records from a higher-education dataset.
example.policyBody: This is an example organization rule, not a law or certification. Exports above 500 records need steward review. A smaller export is not automatically compliant.
example.allowedBody: At 500 records or fewer, this example request can proceed without steward review.
example.heldBody: Above 500 records, the example request waits for a steward decision.
example.approvedBody: The example reviewer approved this exact row count. Nothing was exported.
example.rejectedBody: The example reviewer rejected this request. It stays blocked in this example.
example.invalidatedBody: The earlier example decision no longer applies. Check the request again.
example.scopeNote: Runs only in your browser on sample data. It makes zero calls to business systems.

diagram.connectionLine: We configure scoped connections with your team for each workflow you bring.
